Custom Card Design Instructions
  • You can upload any custom design, any colours
  • Submit an image for the card front and card back
  • Only .png or .jpg (RGB) files accepted
  • Leave space on the card back design for a QR code that we generate for you
  • In the card edit screen, drag the the generated QR code on the card back to the right position for your design
  • Save your design configuration
  • Once you happy with your final design, click the Submit button

Your card design should be at least 856px X 540px.
The ratio of width to height should be 865×540 (1.59:1)
